snippet.title: OpenMadoola arcade mode demo Openマドゥーラ アーケード版プレイ映像
snippet.description: This is a video of me playing the arcade mode in OpenMadoola, my Wing of Madoola (マドゥーラの翼) game engine reimplementation for PC. Any frame skipping is an artifact of the video capture and doesn't show up during actual gameplay. For more information, see infochunk.com/madoola/openmadoola.html
